# <Brief title>

## Problem

One or two paragraphs. What is painful or missing today? Be concrete. Name the user, name the situation, name the cost of leaving this unaddressed.

## Why now

Why this problem, at this moment, ahead of other problems. External pressure (customer ask, competitive move, cost blowup), internal readiness (team capacity, unlocked dependency), or expiring window.

## Who feels it

The specific persona from `docs/vision/01-product-vision.md §3`. Plus secondary stakeholders who are affected downstream.

## Success signal

Rough observable outcome. Not a metric target — that comes in pitches/RFCs. One sentence: "we'll know we solved this when ___."

## Out of scope

What this brief explicitly does NOT cover. Prevents scope creep into adjacent problems.

## Next step

Which pitch(es) this brief feeds. Or: "rejected because ___."
